description: Daniel Ddiba and colleagues publish the research inputs behind their study of urban organic-waste recovery and the REVAMP Resource Value Mapping tool. Zenodo lists waste quantities for Kampala, waste-quality properties, treatment-process information, product prices and an Excel macro-enabled calculation workbook. The authors are affiliated with KTH Royal Institute of Technology and Stockholm Environment Institute. The deposit dates from January 2021; its landing page does not specify all measurement periods, price years or sampling resolutions. CSV tables, the XLSM workbook and explanatory text files are freely available under CC BY 4.0. The files can support comparisons of treatment capacity and recoverable-resource value, with transfer to another city requiring local inputs. Macros and calculations were not executed. The related REVAMP tool already has a first-review draft, but that draft does not explicitly identify this distinct input-data deposit.
